title: Trump signals diplomatic push on Ukraine and Iran as diesel ban looms
summary: The US President Donald Trump, after finishing his meeting with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy, said that he is figuring out a solution to end the war. Furthermore, he added that Russian President Vladimir Putin is willing to meet to end the war.

title: South Korean Won: Export surge supports KRW recovery – OCBC
summary: OCBC strategists Sim Moh Siong and Christopher Wong report that the Korean Won (KRW) strengthened alongside gains in tech equities, lower Oil prices and strong export data, including a surge in semiconductor shipments.

title: US Dollar Index pushes higher on the case for another Fed increase
summary: The Dollar Index trades near 100.70, its highest level since late July. It has climbed through five straight sessions of falling Crude Oil, the opposite of how the war has moved it for most of this year. The Fed is the reason.
